reason: I forget pills at home all the time, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is the one thing here that fits my life. At $24.99 for the first box and with the money-back thing, I'd try one box, not two.
objection: It's still two capsules every day and $30 a month is a lot on my budget when I already have a drawer of half-used bottles I never finished.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price per box, around $19 to $20, or a smaller trial box so I don't pay for 30 days before I know I'll stick with it.
